_version: themes-v1 — 고양이 카페 + 벚꽃 온실 정원 (adds to room-assets-v5 / v5-tiles; v5 ids unchanged)
_placeholders: price, ownedDefault, nameKo, unlock rules, COZY Lv and hint copy are PLACEHOLDERS
crossThemeRule: every item/tile may be placed in ANY room; theme is only a shop/drawer filter tag

rules.furniture: draw so anchorFootprintCenterPx lands on footprint centre P(c+w/2,r+d/2), P(c,r)=(1920+(c-r)*78, 900+(c+r)*39) world px. Default faces +row (back to right wall, row 0); _m faces +col (back to left wall). Rotate = swap image + footprint. All edges are exactly ±26.57° (2:1).
rules.wall: front/_L/_R images are already at world display size. _L/_R are sheared x′=0.894x, y′=y∓0.5x′. Position: base P(0,t) (left) / P(t,0) (right), raised heightUnits×3 px, image centred there.
rules.tiles: same as v5-tiles tileRules (floor 160×82 iso by parity; wall strips 82×493, right strips pre-shaded ×0.88).
rules.scale: 1×1 furniture ≈ 0.72–0.84 tile width; small props (소품) intentionally smaller (0.45–0.7). Nothing larger than 2×2.
rules.sorting: floor items depth (c+w-1)+(r+d-1), tie c-r; floor-decal (picnic_blanket) first; shadows under everything except koi_pond/picnic_blanket.
